findings.text: Ask 5.1 breaks ask 6.1. `ChatWriter.last_message_id` (`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js:91`) only reads `messages.add` lines. It ignores the `messages.move` line that `ChatWriter.move_line` (`:147`) writes for a new topic. Example: Prompt m-B is open, the seat adds task card m-T, then moves m-B below it. The list ends in m-B, but the file's newest add is m-T. So `owner()` (`:62`) starts a new Prompt instead of growing the moved one; before this diff `st.last` grew m-B correctly. A `remove` has the same problem. A simpler fix: read the last id from the replayed list (`session._messages.messages.at(-1)?.id`), which `move_line` already uses, instead of scanning the raw text. Add the move case to `ChatWriter.order.test.mjs`.

`Sessions.js` changed, but no test that loads it was run. The worktree has no node_modules, so `chat-messages.test.mjs`, `Sessions.single.test.mjs` (which holds the 900-word brief check) and `Sessions.test.mjs` could not start (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, which I reproduced). Run them against the branch before merging; the brief is 891 words, only 9 under the limit.

Stale doc (law 9): `ext/Chat/v3/readme.md:15` still says a Reply's Prompt is "the one whose `sentences` holds its `re.to`". After `placement.js:13`, arrival order wins when a newer Prompt sits in between. `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md:6` (the reply drawn beside its sentence) also needs the trade-off that `placement-defaults.md` names.

Unindexed test: `Servex/readme.md:45` lists ChatWriter's tests as `chat-messages.test.mjs` and `ChatWriter.move.test.mjs`, but not the new `ChatWriter.order.test.mjs`. It also does not say that the next owner sentence now checks the session file for messages from other writers.

Ask 4 ("if something does, fix it") is only half done. V1 (`ux/Dictate/Widget.js`, `chat.js`) still draws from `{chat}` lines, not `session.messages`, and V1 is still the default view (`ext/Chat/v3/readme.md:3`). The brief allowed listing it in `ai/todo.md`, which was done, but the view the owner sees by default is still not the one-truth list.

The task checkbox is a `☐ ` character inside the title text (`ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js:242`), not a checkbox you can tick. It has no browser test (filed in todo.md). Fine as a first version, but say so if the owner expects to tick it.

Ask 6.1 "a new topic moves it to a new paragraph in one step" becomes a new card, not a paragraph. Stored paragraphs were declined with a proposal (`ux/Dictate/doc/placement-defaults.md`, ask 6 item 4) and a todo line. The decline is reasonable and recorded.
The brief asked for each part as its own commit. A (the audit) and C (the defaults) share commit `fcc27e457`; B1 and B2 have their own. The branch `worktree/voice-place` is not merged yet.
